convertibility_reason: Grid/martingale strategy with margin-dependent lot scaling (LotExponent), heavy use of custom HedgeTerminal .mqh libraries (Prototypes.mqh, TradeState.mqh, Environment.mqh, Indicators.mqh, DrawHedgePosition.mqh) for hedging position management, dynamic pip-step grid, and proprietary transaction selection API that cannot be trivially replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: DynamicPips (dynamic grid step)
derived_values.formula: MathRound((iHighest(1,Glubina) - iLowest(1,Glubina)) / DEL / _Point), clamped to [DefaultPips/DEL, DefaultPips*DEL]

derived_values.name: AveragePrice (weighted average entry price of all positions)

other_exits: CCI exit: closes all positions if CCI > CCILevel (500) and direction is SHORT, or CCI < -CCILevel and direction is LONG
Equity stop: closes all positions if floating profit is negative and exceeds TotalEquityRisk% of high equity, with profit below EquityPercent threshold
Time stop: closes all positions if hours since first position open >= MaxTradeOpenHours

position_sizing.conditional_logic: First position uses fixed Lots; subsequent averaging positions use GetLot() which applies LotExponent compounding based on current position count

custom_logic_notes: This is a martingale/grid EA (Ilan-type). When the last position is in loss exceeding DynamicPips, it opens an averaging position in the same direction with a multiplied lot size (LotExponent). DynamicPips is calculated from the High-Low range of the last Glubina bars divided by DEL, clamped between DefaultPips/DEL and DefaultPips*DEL. All positions share a common TP calculated from the weighted average entry price. SL/TP are recalculated for all positions whenever a new position is added. The trailing stop only activates when UseTrailingStop=true and UseStopLoss=false. The EA uses the HedgeTerminal virtual position management system (FOREACH_POSITION, TransactionSelect, HedgePositionGetDouble, SendTradeRequest, IF_LONG, IF_SHORT, IF_FROZEN macros) which is an MT5-specific hedging framework with no Python equivalent.
python_conversion_notes: Major challenge: the HedgeTerminal API (Prototypes.mqh, Environment.mqh, TradeState.mqh) provides virtual hedging position management with macros like FOREACH_POSITION, IF_LONG, IF_SHORT, IF_FROZEN, TransactionSelect, HedgePositionGetDouble, SendTradeRequest. This entire layer must be reimplemented in Python using a net-position or per-trade tracking system. The martingale lot scaling requires careful margin checking not present in the original code. The CEnvironment class (AveragePrice, GetPositionsTotal, CurrentDirection, FirstPosOpen, GetHighEquity, etc.) must be fully reverse-engineered from the .mqh file. The trailing stop and equity stop logic runs intrabar (every tick), while entry logic is bar-based. RSI and CCI are standard and trivially convertible. The grid step (DynamicPips) calculation using iHighest/iLowest needs replacement with pandas/numpy rolling max/min. CTrade from Trade\Trade.mqh maps to MetaTrader5 Python API order_send.
